title: Band uniforms and Noble Sissle; union gold card
summary: Bands had uniforms with names on the caps, Noble Sissle brought it to New York, and Foster has his Local 802 gold card.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: You see, there's a lot of the guys, see now we, there's something else we used to do down there. Because all the bands down there had their uniforms and their names on the cap of the band. Yeah. See, now that came out of New York, Noble Sissons tried to bring that up in New York, because the band come back from overseas, he had the bands with the caps on them. See, with Noble up on that. How about him? He's running New York. He's running for president once, but he didn't get the first base. He would have made it. See, but he let him put another guy, his two colored runners, two colored runners, one white. You know what I mean? The white was a Jew boy, two colored. Now if he just run. They got together, yeah. One of them. One.
See, it was three runs for president, two was colored. If he'd have run, because he almost won. If he'd have got the votes and some of that, see. They're all both done together.
You remember that? I remember hearing something about it that time. I don't remember what year it was. Yeah.
I got my gold card out of it, 802. I don't pay no more dues, eh? Well, you have.
All right. I'll find my one.
Yeah, uniforms, yeah. Yeah, we are.
